name: Gorgias
description: Gorgias is an ecommerce customer-service platform for tickets, shared inboxes, chat, social messaging, voice, automation, macros, routing, customer context, and support analytics.
agentUseSummary: Enter one Gorgias account domain, dedicated user email, and customer-owned API key, then let selected agents use content-free ticket operations or approved documented API requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: GORGIAS_USERNAME
credentialRequirements.label: Gorgias API username
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the email of a dedicated Gorgias user whose role grants only required operations.

credentialRequirements.name: GORGIAS_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Gorgias API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a revocable private-app access token for the dedicated user.

capabilities.label: Read ticket operations
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded ticket operational metadata without subjects, summaries, customers, messages, source addresses, assignees, tags, satisfaction, custom fields, metadata, events, or raw records.

capabilities.label: Gorgias API
capabilities.description: Use documented tenant-bound API paths and methods allowed by the connected API key user's role.

approvalRequired.label: List ticket metadata
approvalRequired.description: List one fixed first page of content-free Gorgias ticket summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read ticket metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Gorgias ticket through Relay's content-free projection.

approvalRequired.label: Use Gorgias API
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Gorgias API operation authorized by the API key user's role; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Content-free ticket reads and every broader API operation require approval; tenant binding, Basic-auth secret isolation, user roles, bounds, and limits remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected role-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; tenant binding, Basic-auth secret isolation, bounds, audits, roles, and Gorgias limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted username/API key only to the tenant-bound Gorgias API origin.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted username/API key only to the tenant-bound Gorgias API origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Gorgias account domain plus dedicated user email and API key with appropriate role permissions are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated least-privilege Gorgias user and revocable private-app API key, enter the domain/email/key in Relay, and verify bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader operations, rate limits, role removal, key rotation, revocation, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Gorgias's official authentication documentation defines tenant-specific gorgias.com origins, HTTP Basic authentication using username plus API key, private-app access tokens, revocation, and user-role-derived permissions.
Gorgias's official API reference defines the tenant-bound /api/tickets list endpoint, cursor pagination, deterministic ordering, filters, and a 1-100 limit.
Gorgias documents API-key and OAuth rate limits, HTTP 429 behavior, Retry-After, and X-Gorgias-Account-Api-Call-Limit response headers.
